illustration: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original concept illustration for a Korean fan port of Dragon Quest IV to Super Famicom. Newly compose and draw, do not recreate any existing box art, screenshot, logo or fan art. Landscape 3:2 illustration. A kindly middle-aged moustached soldier in rose-pink plate armor and pink helmet with a small gold crest, brown boots and a sword at his hip, walks across a mossy stone bridge beside a small cheerful floating blue jellyfish companion with golden dangling tendrils. The soldier is Ragnar/Ryan inspired, the companion Healie inspired. A distant medieval castle, green rolling hills, white wildflowers, winding stream, soft dawn sky. Rich handmade gouache and ink storybook illustration, lively charming faces, strong silhouette, restrained warm pink armor and cool turquoise landscape, beautiful deliberate linework and detailed vegetation, full-bleed clean art, no frames or labels. No text, no watermark, no UI. This is concept artwork, not a spritesheet.
title: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW Korean title-screen illustration for a Super Famicom Dragon Quest IV fan port. The attached image is the Nintendo DS original title screen, provided ONLY as art-direction reference: capture the recognizable Dragon Quest mood, NOT the DS screen layout, copyright text or exact original pixels. Landscape aspect 8:7, designed to remain readable downscaled to 256x224. Classical 16-bit Japanese RPG title art, strong clean pixel clusters, restrained palette, not a modern indie logo. At upper left a small powerful blue dragon flies into the frame, leathery bronze wings, curved long tail. Sky filled with dramatic lavender, peach and gold clouds, warm luminous horizon. Center-lower area dominated by the EXACT Korean title '드래곤 퀘스트', crafted as a distinctive sculpted crimson and gold fantasy logo with deep maroon shadows, beveled antique gold edges, bold angular Korean strokes with large counters. A silver sword accents the right edge of the logo. Below: very large gold Roman numeral 'IV'. Small clear subtitle '인도받은 자들'. A small distant ivory celestial castle at lower right, partly emerging from clouds. The Dragon Quest red/gold identity, winged dragon and luminous sky are essential. No moon, no starry night, no giant sword behind the letters, no generic medieval badge, no English, no copyright text, no watermark, no console border. Newly compose and draw all artwork.
